response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an acute illness (acute upper respiratory infection) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 explicitly covers 'reasonable and necessary costs for outpatient care, hospitalization, and medications prescribed by a doctor, if incurred as a result of an acute illness or injury during the trip.' The evidence confirms the acute nature of the illness and that treatment was received abroad, which aligns with the coverage provided under this clause. No exclusions apply, as there is no indication of pre-existing conditions, alcohol use, extreme sports, or other excluded causes."}
